verdict.rationale: Formant documents a Docker-based agent installer for ROS1/ROS2 devices, reusable device configuration exported as YAML or saved as templates, and teleoperation that can publish to ROS topics. Together these speed up onboarding a robot onto the platform and getting first remote control. It does not provide hardware drivers or low-level bring-up, and nothing evidences the hours-versus-weeks speed claim beyond the marketing line 'minimal lift'. Missing for 10: driver/hardware bring-up tooling, evidence of time-to-first-motion, independent or hands-on corroboration of fast onboarding.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can bring up a new robot — drivers, configuration, first motion — in hours rather than weeks

citations.quote: Install the Formant agent on a ROS1 device by running the Docker-based installer.
export the configuration to a YAML (from the device configuration), or save the configuration as a template
Easily connect to multiple robot types with minimal lift.
allows you to remotely control your device via a real-time, peer-to-peer connection between your device and the Formant web application over WebRTC.
